candidate: Working tree after final matte deck material refinement; identified by sourceHashes.after.
method: Visible scene-graph inventory after real material batching and instancing. Triangles include instance counts; bytes count unique geometry attributes and indices, excluding textures/driver storage. This is deterministic submitted-geometry potential, not frustum-culling-aware renderer timings or GPU-memory telemetry.

fixture.baseline: Fresh source-only git archive of the named commit; features, lib, scripts and package manifests only. Shared installed node_modules via symlink. No environment files, persisted state, databases or uploads copied. Temporary baseline removed after measurement.
fixture.modelOptions: Production createSpacecraft(THREE) defaults; home at time 0, delta 0, immediate doors; wide and compact layouts measured independently.
fixture.architectureCheck: Same production model state; compare shared framing metadata, actual continuous cabin-lining bounds, and separate complete pressure-structure assembly bounds for every cabin in both layouts. The complete assembly includes removable fixture hardware.

before.digestMethod: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify(files), with file keys sorted lexicographically; each value is the raw-file SHA-256.

after.method: Visible scene-graph inventory after real material batching and instancing. Triangles include instance counts; bytes count unique geometry attributes and indices, excluding textures/driver storage. This is deterministic submitted-geometry potential, not frustum-culling-aware renderer timings or GPU-memory telemetry.

interpretation.triangles: Geometry submission potential with instance multiplicity, before camera culling. Not measured per-pass GPU triangles.
interpretation.meshes: Visible scene-graph mesh count after production batching, a potential submission count. Not a renderer draw-call measurement; frustum culling and shadow/AO passes are excluded.
interpretation.attributeBytes: Sum of unique geometry attribute and index typed arrays retained in the visible scene graph. Excludes textures, instance transforms, JavaScript object overhead, temporary construction allocations, driver storage and total process/GPU memory.
interpretation.rendering: Node fixture omits document/canvas-created text and display artwork and uses no actual WebGL rendering. Identical omissions apply to both variants.
interpretation.noTimingClaims: No frame timing, startup/decode/upload measurements, thermal/power/battery observations or performance gain claimed. Design work establishes a new baseline; held optimization candidates remain held.
interpretation.pressureStructureAssemblyBounds: The pressure-structure group includes ceiling fixtures. Removing the former roof-latches lowers each group maximum Y by approximately 0.005 units because those latches extended above the ceiling. Actual continuous cabin-lining bounds and shared framing metadata are unchanged; source and numeric bounds are retained here.
